recipe.visualDefinition: A surreal 1980s-inspired composition featuring two figures in dynamic, gravity-defying poses submerged in a deep blue underwater environment, framed by arched, multi-colored geometric typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Figures interacting with an invisible central axis
High-contrast fashion textures against soft aquatic backgrounds
Arched text following the movement of the subjects
Vibrant neon accents contrasting with deep blue ocean tones
coreInvariants: Deep blue underwater coral reef background
Distressed denim and leather fashion elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures occupying the middle ground; one standing vertically, one crouching horizontally, creating a 'V' shape.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical figure on the left with a bright yellow jacket interior.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion starting from the top-left text, following the arch down to the bottom-left, then jumping to the crouching figure on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep blue water at the corners and center-right provides breathing room for the busy fashion textures.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Yellow and White (Jacket lining and T-shirt)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon Green, Magenta, and Orange (Typography and Tie-dye)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground subjects and text against a medium-value, textured blue background.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme horizontal stretching/warping to follow arcs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are sheared and rotated to maintain a perpendicular relationship to the curve of the path.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying colors and arc directions for rhythm.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 80s aesthetic and circular letterforms.
Provides the necessary geometric rigidity and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast underwater scene with a coral reef floor. Two people in 80s streetwear (distressed denim, leather jackets, tie-dye) are floating in dynamic, gravity-defying poses. The lighting is directional from above, creating sharp highlights on the clothing.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply uppercase geometric sans-serif text in two large arcs: one arching over the top and one arching under the bottom. Use a gradient of neon green, orange, and magenta for the letters.

verificationChecks: Text follows a smooth circular arc
Colors are vibrant neon against a dark blue background

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the models
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is warped correctly along the curve
Check that the yellow jacket interior pops against the blue
Verify the 'weightless' quality of the subjects' hair and clothes
Confirm the background has a distinct coral/seabed texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Underwater Surrealism] + [80s Streetwear Fashion] + [Arched Geometric Neon Typography] to create a dynamic retro-pop visual.
